## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Motion graphics
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Motion graphics composition
//  - IProcedural motion and paths
//  - Motion timing and exposure

//==
// # Motion graphics composition
//
// After-Effects-style composition and choreography
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motion_graphics): layer transforms,
// single-value tweens, timelines of named spans, staggered group timing, and
// the repeater and echo effects that duplicate a layer through space and time.
// Durations are offsets from the owning composition's start.

// How a finished animation continues: play through and end (Once), restart
// from the beginning (Loop), alternate forward and reverse passes (PingPong),
// or play once and hold the final value (Hold).
type PlaybackCycle = Once | Loop | PingPong | Hold;

// An After-Effects-style 2D layer transform. Rotation and scale pivot about
// Anchor, expressed in the layer's own coordinates; Position places the anchor
// in the parent's coordinates. Opacity composites the layer over its backdrop.
type LayerTransform2D
    implements IValue
{
    Anchor: Point2D;
    Position: Point2D;
    Rotation: Angle;
    Scale: Number2;
    Opacity: Proportion;
}

// A single eased transition of one value: From at the start to To at the end of
// Duration, shaped by Easing, after an initial Delay. Sampling before the delay
// yields From; after Delay + Duration, To.
// T must be Interpolatable: blending From and To is the whole of Sample.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inbetweening)
type Tween<T>
    where T: IInterpolatable
    implements ITimeVarying<T>
{
    From: T;
    To: T;
    Duration: Duration;
    Delay: Duration;
    Easing: ClassicEasing;
}

// A named span scheduled on a timeline. Start is the offset from the timeline's
// start; Easing shapes the item's local progress over its Duration.
type TimelineItem
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Start: Duration;
    Duration: Duration;
    Easing: ClassicEasing;
}

// An ordered schedule of named spans. Duration is the total length; items may
// overlap and need not cover the whole span.
type Timeline
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Duration: Duration;
    Items: Array<TimelineItem>;
}

// Which end of a staggered group starts animating first: ripple from the
// first item, from the last, outward from the middle, or in random order.
type StaggerOrigin = First | Last | Center | Random;

// Offsets copies of one animation across a group of items: item i starts
// ItemDelay after its predecessor in ripple order. Easing reshapes the delay
// distribution across the group (ease-in bunches early items together).
type Stagger
    implements IValue
{
    Count: Integer;
    ItemDelay: Duration;
    Origin: StaggerOrigin;
    Easing: ClassicEasing;
}

// Duplicates a layer with a cumulative transform: copy i applies Offset i
// times, fading opacity toward EndOpacity across the run of copies.
type MotionRepeater2D
    implements IValue
{
    Copies: Integer;
    Offset: LayerTransform2D;
    EndOpacity: Proportion;
}

// A trailing-echo effect: the layer is re-composited Count times at Spacing
// intervals behind the current time, each echo's opacity scaled by Decay
// relative to the previous.
type MotionEcho
    implements IValue
{
    Count: Integer;
    Spacing: Duration;
    Decay: Proportion;
}

//==
// # IProcedural motion and paths
//
// Motion generated by a function rather than by keys: periodic oscillators,
// seeded fractal wiggle, camera shake, and placement along a 2D or 3D path.
// Seeded effects replay identically for equal seeds.

// The waveform of a procedural oscillator; Noise is smooth pseudo-random.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waveform)
type OscillatorWaveform = Sine | Square | Triangle | Sawtooth | Noise;

// A periodic scalar signal for procedural animation:
// Bias + Amplitude * wave(Frequency * time + Phase). Phase shifts the waveform;
// Bias recenters it. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oscillation)
type Oscillator
    implements IValue, ITimeVarying<Number>
{
    Waveform: OscillatorWaveform;
    Amplitude: Number;
    Frequency: Frequency;
    Phase: Angle;
    Bias: Number;
}

// After-Effects-style wiggle: smooth fractal noise added to a property.
// Frequency is the base wiggle rate; each of Octaves noise layers doubles the
// frequency and multiplies amplitude by Persistence. Seed selects the noise
// stream, so equal seeds replay identical motion.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fractional_Brownian_motion)
type WiggleMotion
    implements IValue
{
    Frequency: Frequency;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Amplitude: Number;
    Persistence: Number;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Animates position along a 2D path. Progress in [0, 1] maps to arc length;
// StartOffset shifts the starting point along the path; when OrientToPath is
// true the moving element rotates to face along the path's tangent.
type MotionPath2D
    implements IValue
{
    Path: Path2D;
    OrientToPath: Boolean;
    StartOffset: Proportion;
}
```
